E0147

Two `{}` holes in a str-match pattern with no literal text between them (D-PARSESTR1/D-PARSESTR2)

What

Two `{}` holes in a str-match pattern with no literal text between them (D-PARSESTR1/D-PARSESTR2)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0147

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0147: tests/ui/parse_pattern_adjacent_holes.stderr.

Error [E0147]: these two `{}` holes have nothing between them to split on
  --> tests/ui/parse_pattern_adjacent_holes.jet:4:11
    |
  4 |         "{a}{b}" -> print("{a}{b}")
    |           ^^^^
 Why: a pattern splits the matched text at the fixed characters between holes; back-to-back holes give it nothing to split on
 Fix: put literal text between them, or type them so the boundary is unambiguous
